cluster_name.description: Optional cluster name filter; use an empty string to query all clusters.

index_name.description: Optional index name filter; use an empty string to query all indices.

lookback.description: Lookback window as ES|QL time span text (e.g. 15 minutes, 1 hour, 24 hours).

configuration.query:
FROM .monitoring-es-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - TO_TIMEDURATION(?lookback)
| WHERE metricset.name == "index"
| WHERE elasticsearch.cluster.name IS NOT NULL AND elasticsearch.index.name IS NOT NULL
| WHERE (?cluster_name == "" OR elasticsearch.cluster.name == ?cluster_name)
| WHERE (?index_name == "" OR elasticsearch.index.name == ?index_name)
| STATS search_total = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.search.query_total), search_time_ms = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.search.query_time_in_millis), docs_total = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.docs.count), segments_count = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.segments.count), request_cache_hits = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.request_cache.hit_count), request_cache_misses = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.request_cache.miss_count), query_cache_evictions = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.query_cache.evictions), fielddata_memory_bytes = MAX(elasticsearch.index.total.fielddata.memory_size_in_bytes) BY elasticsearch.cluster.name, elasticsearch.index.name
| EVAL avg_query_latency_ms = CASE(search_total > 0, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(search_time_ms) / search_total, 2), 0), pressure_score = CASE(search_total > 0, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(search_time_ms) / search_total, 2), 0) + COALESCE(search_total, 0) + COALESCE(query_cache_evictions, 0) + COALESCE(fielddata_memory_bytes, 0) / 1048576
| SORT avg_query_latency_ms DESC, search_total DESC
| LIMIT 25

description: Find high search volume or slow searches by index.
